data.name: Manta Ray Night Snorkel
data.headline: Likely To Sell Out | Reserve Your Seat Today | Free 24-Hour Cancellations
data.description: Join a 1.5-hour manta ray night snorkeling tour departing from Honokohau Harbor in Kona. Swim among wild manta rays feeding on plankton attracted to a lightboard while guided by a professional snorkel guide. Tours offer a sunset option for early departures and water entry at twilights, and later experiences for more experienced snorkelers comfortable entering the water in the dark. Expect up-close viewing of manta rays with wingspans up to 16 feet, a safe guided environment, and refreshments after the swim.

highlight_box.title: Manta Ray Guarantee
highlight_box.description: We guarantee you will see at least one manta ray on this tour. In the rare instances where the manta rays do not appear, you will be provided a credit for any future tour with availability.

data.highlights:
* Swim with Kona’s majestic manta rays in their natural habitat
* Up to 45 minutes of snorkeling in plankton-rich waters
* Learn about manta rays and marine conservation from your guide
* Sunset experience for early tours or a quieter nighttime option for late tours
data.itinerary:
1. Check-in: Arrive at Honokohau Harbor 15 minutes before departure. Meet at the pavilion near the restrooms.
2. Boat ride: Enjoy a 25-minute boat ride to the manta ray site.
3. Snorkeling: Spend up to 45 minutes in the water, holding onto a lightboard while watching manta rays feed.
4. Return: After the snorkeling experience, return to the harbor with refreshments provided.

data.booking_notes:
##Tour Booking Confirmation

Your Manta Ray Snorkeling Tour reservation is confirmed, and we’re excited to see you soon! In the meantime, please read the information below and call us at 808-987-1584 if we can help with anything.

_________________
##Meet Us At Honokohau Harbor

Please arrive 30 minutes before your tour’s departure time. We’ll meet you at the pavilion at Honokohau Harbor, near the restrooms on the north side of the harbor. When you turn off the highway towards the harbor, make your first right (there will be several large rocks on the corner), then follow the road past the fuel station on your left, and turn left after the fuel station. You will turn into a large parking lot, and you will see a pavilion (overhang with benches around the perimeter) next to the restrooms. Our crew will meet you at the pavilion, just before your time of departure, and will escort you to the vessel after checking you in.

The Honokohau Harbor is on Kealakehe Pkwy in Kailua-Kona, HI 96740. [View the Google map for precise directions.](https://goo.gl/maps/rQtbFq4FB9CFUcmU7)

Please note that our tours typically leave on time. If you are going to be late, please call us.
_________________
##This Tour Includes
- Bottled water & nonalcoholic drinks 
- Snorkeling gear
- Lightboard to attract plankton and manta rays
- Wetsuit (optional)
- Professional snorkel guide

_____________________________
##Things To Bring

We recommend wearing your swimsuit to the harbor, and applying reef-safe sunscreen before you board the vessel. A towel, hat, and sunglasses are also recommended.

This tour includes snorkeling gear, and you are welcome to bring your own.

You may bring your own waterproof camera, or you can rent a GoPro from us. If you would like to rent a GoPro, please call us to reserve one for your tour.


_________________
##Snorkeling Gear
Our boat is fully equipped with quality snorkeling gear and fins for you. If you have your own gear, you're welcome to bring it.
_________________
##Motion Sickness

If you get motion sickness, we recommend taking an over-the-counter medication such as non-drowsy Bo-nine. Many guests also find relief from using the wristbands that apply pressure to your wrists.

_________________
##Tipping 

Our staff appreciates tips from happy customers, and will gladly accept cash, venmo, paypal, and other popular payment methods.
_________________
##Weather Conditions

Kona’s ocean waters are typically calm, but we are sometimes forced to reschedule tours due to unsafe conditions. If high winds or surf are forecasted for the day of your tour, please have your phone available in case we need to contact you. Any cancellations due to weather will be issued a trip on another tour, or a full refund.

data.special_requirements:
Requirements:
- Swim without the assistance of a flotation device.
- Proficient at snorkeling.
- Able to climb a short ladder to re-board the boat.
On the rare occasion where zero manta rays are sighted on your tour, you will be issued a credit to attend a future tour at no additional cost. Based on availability. No refunds given.

data.faqs:
What should I wear?
Wear your swimsuit to the harbor and bring a towel and a warm coverup for afterward.
What if I get seasick?
It is recommended to take motion sickness medication before boarding if you are prone to seasickness.
Can I bring my own snorkel gear?
Yes, you are welcome to bring your own gear, though all necessary equipment is provided.
